name: Alphabet Test
shortcutSummary: Memorize EJOTY (E=5, J=10, O=15, T=20, Y=25) to instantly locate any letter's position. For opposite letters, sum is always 27 (A+Z=27, B+Y=27).
conceptExplanation: Alphabet Test questions involve finding letter positions, forming meaningful words from jumbled letters, and letter arrangement puzzles. They frequently appear in SSC and Banking exams.

subtopics.explanation: Alphabet Test questions involve finding letter positions, forming meaningful words from jumbled letters, and letter arrangement puzzles. They frequently appear in SSC and Banking exams.
shortcuts: EJOTY Method: E=5, J=10, O=15, T=20, Y=25 — anchor points for quick calculation
Opposite Letter Sum = 27: A(1)+Z(26)=27, B(2)+Y(25)=27, and so on
Left-Right Counting: From left = normal position. From right = 27 − position.
